title: Ancient Ayurveda Meets Modern Medicine: Dr. Leah Johansson on Healing and Longevity

content:
Listen on Podbean

Anna Maria and Brian Clement interview Dr. Leah Johansson about Ayurvedic medicine’s ancient wisdom—vata, pitta, kapha—and how personalized diet, mind-body practices, and living foods can support longevity and reverse chronic disease.

The conversation also explores integrating Western medicine with Ayurveda, the role of AI and genetics in future healthcare, and emerging ideas about frequency-based therapies for prevention and healing.
